steps.name: Young Girl
steps.text: Where are we going, Granny?

steps.name: Dignified Grandmother
steps.text: It's not the right time for you to ask.

steps.name: Dignified Grandmother
steps.text: Hold tight to your pouch, and stay close to me.

steps.name: Young Girl
steps.text: Yes, Granny.

steps.name: Dignified Grandmother
steps.text: We're almost there.

steps.name: Young Girl
steps.text: What's that there?

steps.name: Dignified Grandmother
steps.text: An arena. Built by bastards from the Grand Knight Territory.

steps.name: Dignified Grandmother
steps.text: Humph.

steps.name: Young Girl
steps.text: Are we going to see a match?

steps.name: Dignified Grandmother
steps.text: A match? No.

steps.name: Dignified Grandmother
steps.text: I'm taking you for training.

steps.name: Dignified Grandmother
steps.text: Do you still remember the things I taught you?

steps.name: Young Girl
steps.text: Yes, Granny, I haven't forgotten any!

steps.name: Young Girl
steps.text: It's shield up, cannon up, and bombard!

steps.name: Young Girl
steps.text: Eyes on the enemy, watch your ammunition, don't let your cannon go!

steps.name: Young Girl
steps.text: And, um...

steps.name: Young Girl
steps.text: When the cannon fire rings through the air, victory is already within sight!

steps.name: Dignified Grandmother
steps.text: Very good.

steps.name: Dignified Grandmother
steps.text: You're a lot more dependable than your father.

steps.name: Dignified Grandmother
steps.text: At least someone else will remember these before I close my eyes for good.

steps.name: Young Girl
steps.text: Please don't be so gloomy, Granny...

steps.name: Dignified Grandmother
steps.text: Heh. A tree may be a century old, but its roots will all be rotten.

steps.name: Dignified Grandmother
steps.text: Better to be fertilizer for the new buds than to wither away like this.

steps.name: Dignified Grandmother
steps.text: *cough* *cough*...

steps.name: Young Girl
steps.text: Granny!

steps.name: Dignified Grandmother
steps.text: It's all right, it was just a little cough. Nothing to worry about.

steps.name: Dignified Grandmother
steps.text: Your father's generation. Even my few brothers. They've all long forgotten how the Kaliskas came to prosper.

steps.name: Dignified Grandmother
steps.text: Forestry? That forest was given back to us upon our high deeds, upon our cannon fire!

steps.name: Dignified Grandmother
steps.text: 'When the cannon fire rings through the air, victory is already within sight'... All those bastards, with all their money, can't even remember the saying!

steps.name: Young Girl
steps.text: Granny, please don't get angry...

steps.name: Dignified Grandmother
steps.text: Hmph...

steps.name: Dignified Grandmother
steps.text: Greynuty, you're a good sprout.

steps.name: Dignified Grandmother
steps.text: Don't grow twisted.

steps.name: Young Girl
steps.text: Yes, Granny, I won't disappoint you!
The Bloodboil Knightclub's—Butcher of the Field—back after nursing those injuries—as ruthless as ever!!
And on—the other—side—

steps.name: Dignified Grandmother
steps.text: *cough*, *cough* *cough*...
Once the foresting magnate of the south—a name out of the Kaliska Group—
But now an Infected—part of the Pinus Sylvestris Knightclub—
Let's give a big warm welcome to—

steps.name: Young Girl
steps.text: Granny?

steps.name: Young Girl
steps.text: (Huff... relax. Granny already taught me. I can do this.)

steps.name: Young Girl
steps.text: (I'm ready!)
The Ashlock Knight, Greynuty Kaliska!

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: Man, oh, man, Ashley finally takes the field.

steps.name: Iwona
steps.text: She's never in a hurry. Never gives the audience the time of day, either. Reveling just isn't Greynuty.

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: That's her selling point. Some people are suckers for that. Look over there.

steps.name: Excited Fan
steps.text: Greynuty! Greynuty, look at me!!!

steps.name: Iwona
steps.text: Eh... yeah, it works.

steps.name: Iwona
steps.text: There's no faking cheers.

steps.name: Iwona
steps.text: And that posture, the hunker with the cannon, it's got noble written between the lines.

steps.name: Iwona
steps.text: Course I'm still most excited for her to fire off, though.

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: Well, you're gonna get that. The crowd's gone wild hearing the rumbles.

steps.name: Iwona
steps.text: Just wish there was more to get a kick out of.

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: What, you want her bashing with the barrel?

steps.name: Iwona
steps.text: Haha. Man, I hope I see it, if it ever happens.

steps.name: Greatmouth Mob
steps.text: Humongous hatchet meets sturdy shield! Who'll come out on top? We'll just have to wait and see!

steps.name: Greatmouth Mob
steps.text: Switch your terminals on, make your choice, and give your competitor your support!

steps.name: Greatmouth Mob
steps.text: And before we forget, the most important part—grab that chance to stuff your wallet full!

steps.name: Greatmouth Mob
steps.text: Let the match—begiiiiiinnnnnnnn—!

steps.name: Brassrust Knight
steps.text: You'd best hope that hunk of plastic holds out.

steps.name: Brassrust Knight
steps.text: Oripathic filth.

steps.name: Iwona
steps.text: Baah, that's dull. She's not even saying anything.

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: This isn't your first time watching Ashley compete. It's called being serious. D'ja know what being serious is?

steps.name: Iwona
steps.text: But this is mad boring... if you don't vent your feelings, how're you gonna keep momentum against your opponent?

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: Knight competitions aren't yelling contests, jeez. The important thing is to look good standing off.

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: See, just like that. Brassrust's getting forced back, and everyone's on cloud nine, right?

steps.name: Iwona
steps.text: You don't think this match is too calm, though? Barely any active attacks.

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: You've gotta pick your opponents. With knights like Brassrust who go all in on offense, you wanna put together a good defense to be optimal.

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: And Ashley can use her favorite move now.

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: Block with a shield bash, get a shot in. Tried and tested.

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: (Ashley doesn't seem that hungry to attack this match. What's on her mind, huh?)

steps.name: Greatmouth Mob
steps.text: It's a shocker! The Butcher's cleaver has nowhere to go before the Ashlock Knight!

steps.name: Greatmouth Mob
steps.text: Each time he attacks! Each blast he takes! Ingra gives, but he gets nothing!

steps.name: Greatmouth Mob
steps.text: The Ashlock Knight's defense is perfect, and she's making every step forward hers, squeezing down the space the Butcher has to move!

steps.name: Greatmouth Mob
steps.text: Without a doubt, this is a battle of back and forth! We won't know who'll wear the victory laurel until the final moment!

steps.name: Greatmouth Mob
steps.text: Get your terminals out and lay your bets on your knight of choice!

steps.name: Greatmouth Mob
steps.text: Or buy a water bottle with your contestant's logo straight away, specially provided by the Major, and let the crowd around you know just who you support!

steps.name: Greatmouth Mob
steps.text: Order now! We're ready to hook you up, right there in your seats!

steps.name: Iwona
steps.text: That's something they do now?

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: They do, but, uh...

steps.name: Iwona
steps.text: These prices... why don't I just step out of the arena and come back with ten bottles?

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: Haha...

steps.name: Iwona
steps.text: You wouldn't order one...

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: Just one. Just to try, heheh.

steps.name: Brassrust Knight
steps.text: Can you do anything besides shrink behind that plastic board, hmm?

steps.name: Brassrust Knight
steps.text: Hah. You'll have time to scream once I shatter it, rock-festered mouse.

steps.name: Brassrust Knight
steps.text: A petty firm like the Kaliskas would never collect your corpse.

steps.name: Greynuty
steps.text: (Pulls trigger)

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: Whoa, Ashley's pissed now!

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: Ingra's being too cruel, though. What's he keep yanking her sore spots for?

steps.name: Iwona
steps.text: Kaliska Forestry used to be pretty well-known, but you don't hear much about it in the news lately.

steps.name: Iwona
steps.text: Can't be something to do with Greynuty.

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: If they had her doing things, they might still be as big as ever.

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: Doing piss-poor management yourself, taking it out on the others. Not a recipe for company success.

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: I heard it was at the table she got expelled from the family. Facing her uncles and aunts. Voted out by all.

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: Unanimous passage...

steps.name: Iwona
steps.text: So her mom and dad...

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: Yeah, I hear blackmail had them throwing their own daughter out.

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: Had the funds for Ashley to head Grand Knight Territory-ways later, though.

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: But'cha probably figure, y'know. There's your parents, and everything sensible says they oughta be with you. And they put their hands up too...

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: That's just gotta hurt.

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: Good thing Ashley's strong enough stuff.

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: Especially strong.

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: Uh... she can't be pissed for REAL real.

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: Lemme look—

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: We're good, we're good.

steps.name: Iwona
steps.text: It's normal enough to be mad at a time like this, right?

steps.name: Iwona
steps.text: For sure, I'd ream a hole straight through Brassrust before thinking about the rest.

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: Ashley takes fights too cerebral, and ammo runs out. If she fires a round throwing a fit, she might just be boned.

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: Still oughta be the phase where she makes Brassrust THINK she's angry.

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: After all, misleading your opponent's important too.

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: Look.

steps.name: Greatmouth Mob
steps.text: I'm floored, and I bet you are too! Ingra's shoulder plates have been blasted to smithereens!

steps.name: Greatmouth Mob
steps.text: The Ashlock Knight is still pressing forward step by step! Could victory be at hand? Is the proclamation coming?!

steps.name: Greatmouth Mob
steps.text: Another crack of shellfire! It looks like the Ashlock Knight's got her own personal victory salute covered!

steps.name: Greatmouth Mob
steps.text: What's this?! Did you see that, everyone?!

steps.name: Greatmouth Mob
steps.text: Brassrust just cleaved a shell apart with his hatchet! We'd be remiss not to thank our two contestants! You only get spectacles like this on the soaps!

steps.name: Greatmouth Mob
steps.text: That's right, I'm talking about the classic scene from the Słoma-funded suspense-in-the-city production, 24 Nights in the G.K.T.! Anyone in the audience interested, you can put an order in for the discs straight away!

steps.name: Greatmouth Mob
steps.text: The first thirty to buy'll get a poster signed by the two leads! First come, first served! Don't miss out!

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: Glug, glug—phew. Man, this is basically the same as convenience store water.

steps.name: Iwona
steps.text: Didn't I warn you already...

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: Heehee. Whatever, let's just say I bought it for her.

steps.name: Iwona
steps.text: Forget that. Mob never misses a chance to shill, huh. Really gets on your nerves...

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: That's his job, isn't it? What else would he do?

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: Who thought Brassrust could cut a shell clean through, though? Really forced an ad spot right into Mob's lap.

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: If only Ashley didn't go soft for a moment. Wanted to knock Brassrust down, didn't aim for his head...

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: Match would've been over by now.

steps.name: Iwona
steps.text: Her magazine's gotta be drying up.

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: Mmm.

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: Only one shot left, I think.

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: Time to swap mags.

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: Here's hoping Ingra doesn't give our Ashley any trouble then.

steps.name: Greynuty
steps.text: (One round left.)

steps.name: Greynuty
steps.text: (Gotta push him off, hop back on the recoil, and that should give me enough time.)

steps.name: Greynuty
steps.text: (With Ingra's competition style, he shouldn't have any out.)

steps.name: Greynuty
steps.text: (This is the moment.)

steps.name: Brassrust Knight
steps.text: Is that all you can do?

steps.name: Greynuty
steps.text: (He sped up?)

steps.name: Greynuty
steps.text: (Shit!)

steps.name: Iwona
steps.text: Is that a—thruster on Brassrust's shoes?

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: There's a wrench in the plan...

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: You've got this, Ashley!

steps.name: Greynuty
steps.text: *cough*...

steps.name: Brassrust Knight
steps.text: You're out of shells. What else can you do?

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: D'ya still have ammo, Ashley?

steps.name: Greynuty
steps.text: None. I just used the reserve to block the bolts.

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: What now, then? Gonna bash with the barrel?

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: If you need it, I can make a distraction for you.

steps.name: Greynuty
steps.text: And then ride the opportunity to take my points like last time?

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: C'mon, let that go already...

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: We'd only just met then. Be a problem not having your guard up.

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: I won't do it again. We agreed on that.

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: I can trust you not to sacrifice other Infected for your own benefit, Greynuty.

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: So you can trust Sona here not to stab you in the back.

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: Right?

steps.name: Greynuty
steps.text: Hmph. I suppose.

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: So how are you gonna face down these knights now?

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: I can definitely make you a little space. Shout if you need me.

steps.name: Greynuty
steps.text: I won't.

steps.name: Greynuty
steps.text: I've got my methods.

steps.name: Greatmouth Mob
steps.text: Fresh from the advantage, the Ashlock Knight has been caught out reloading! Brassrust begins his revenge! Could the Butcher's cleaver taste blood when all's said and done?!

steps.name: Greatmouth Mob
steps.text: Just how is the Ashlock Knight gonna counter? There she goes—she's thrown her empty magazine at Brassrust, but it's had no—

steps.name: Greatmouth Mob
steps.text: Oh, wait a moment, sister, she's thrown her cannon down too and is charging Brassrust! What is she up to?!

steps.name: Greatmouth Mob
steps.text: Ingra's got his weapon up, and the Ashlock Knight only has a shield to her name! Ashlock—Ashlock has blocked the battleaxe, and—ooh!! She's clocked him straight in the head! I heard that all the way from here!

steps.name: Greatmouth Mob
steps.text: Ooh! Back-to-back and hand-to-hand! It's a barrage! Ingra's on the retreat!

steps.name: Greatmouth Mob
steps.text: Greynuty's rolled right back to her weapon, swapped and loaded! Not a beat missed! Is Ingra in for another artillery lockdown?!

steps.name: Greatmouth Mob
steps.text: Ah-ha! We're once again treated to the sound of cannon fire! The Ashlock Knight has the situation back under control!

steps.name: Iwona
steps.text: Might be a little ugly, but... that's a pretty practical way to disengage.

steps.name: Iwona
steps.text: Never dreamt she'd go so fast once she dropped that cannon, though.

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: Ashley's a Zalak too, y'know. A little agility's par for our course.

steps.name: Iwona
steps.text: So why won't she use a light weapon like yours?

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: Personal preference, I guess.

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: I suggested she could switch to a more arena-friendly long-ranger—javelins, crossbows, slings, stuff like that. She's not a fan of any of them. Just likes using that old family cannon.

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: She can't even put it to full use sometimes, and the maintenance is a pain.

steps.name: Iwona
steps.text: That's stubborn, alright.

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: You get used to it, y'know.

steps.name: Iwona
steps.text: I think she's down to her last eight rounds.

steps.name: Iwona
steps.text: If she runs clean out, what happens?

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: I've got no idea. What DOES happen?

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: I've never seen Ashley use up all her reserve ammo before.

steps.name: Brassrust Knight
steps.text: ...*pant*, *pant*—Are you toying with me, Ashlock?!

steps.name: Brassrust Knight
steps.text: Say something—you damned—rock!

steps.name: Greynuty
steps.text: (Pulls trigger)

steps.name: Brassrust Knight
steps.text: How long do you plan on playing the mute?!

steps.name: Brassrust Knight
steps.text: I've had enough—enough of this!

steps.name: Brassrust Knight
steps.text: Hrreaaagh!!

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: Man, Ashley really is another level of horrible.

steps.name: Iwona
steps.text: There's no way she was planning a tug of war with Ingra from the start. Was she?

steps.name: Iwona
steps.text: She doesn't respond, she doesn't go down. She'd get me mad too.
Why?

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: Oh, Justyna, you made it.

steps.name: Justyna
steps.text: Why is Ashlock bent on humiliating Brassrust?

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: Thaaat's a long story.

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: When I ran into Ashley, she was stoked on anger, wrath for all the old knight lords at the top of the stands.

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: The other Infected knights thought she just resented the old guard, pure and simple.

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: But if—

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: If she wasn't an Infected, she'd be a knight noble too.

steps.name: Justyna
steps.text: I've heard.

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: Post-infection, no-one her generation or above in her knight family showed her any sympathy.

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: Everyone put the blame for the family's slow fall on her.

steps.name: Iwona
steps.text: Normal people would know that's nothing to do with getting ill.

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: But that's what they did. Her family, every Kaliska Zalak agreed to strip Ashley of her position and boot her out of the lineage.

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: She used to trust all the family, so much. She loved sharing fun stories with them. Comparing techniques with them.

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: But in the end, no one she thought a friend reached out a hand to help.

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: I heard some were looking to have her disappeared altogether—

steps.name: Iwona
steps.text: It—can't be that bad.

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: One day, I was there. Helped keep them off Ashley.

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: So you can guess why Ashley has such a bitter hatred for the old knight lords.

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: As for Brassrust Ingra...

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: Every single thing he does is a deep sting on Ashley's heart.

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: That's what's going on. I'm guessing it's why she was ready to stand off in a close contest until the end.

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: To bring a lofty, high-ranking knight straight into the ground.

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: And to... keep her own anger in check.

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: Hey, Justyna, can you tell how many shells Ashley has left in her mag for me?

steps.name: Justyna
steps.text: Four.

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: Ooh.

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: Nearly closing time.

steps.name: Greatmouth Mob
steps.text: A fierce offensive has not toppled the Ashlock Knight! And Brassrust is beginning to wear out!

steps.name: Greatmouth Mob
steps.text: He's readying for his final charge!

steps.name: Greatmouth Mob
steps.text: This marathon back-and-forth is about to pay off!

steps.name: Greatmouth Mob
steps.text: Ladies and gentlemen, knights and dames, keep an eye on your betting numbers, please! Who knows if you're suddenly in for a prize when the results come in!

steps.name: Greatmouth Mob
steps.text: This post-match lottery is sponsored by Roar Guards Co., and the rates will boggle your mind! An astonishing zero point FIVE percent! If you still haven't placed your bets, you have one last chance now!

steps.name: Greatmouth Mob
steps.text: Ingra has lifted his hatchet, the blade of the abattoir!

steps.name: Greatmouth Mob
steps.text: Greynuty assumes a defensive position!

steps.name: Greatmouth Mob
steps.text: We're about to see who wins and who loses!

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: Jeez, Louise! When'd Ashley make off with my moves?!

steps.name: Greatmouth Mob
steps.text: Brassrust is charging, he's still charging, Ashlock has her shield up, but she's pointed the barrel backwards!

steps.name: Greatmouth Mob
steps.text: Could she be taking Brassrust for a head-on impact?!

steps.name: Greatmouth Mob
steps.text: Both are coming in hot, red-yellow-white-hot!

steps.name: Greatmouth Mob
steps.text: What?!

steps.name: Greatmouth Mob
steps.text: Ashlock's accelerated with her shelling and has sailed right by Brassrust's hatchet!

steps.name: Greatmouth Mob
steps.text: Too fast, way too fast!!

steps.name: Greatmouth Mob
steps.text: She's ditched her shield, the barrel's against Ingra's back, she's pulled the trigger!!

steps.name: Greatmouth Mob
steps.text: The Brassrust Knight is down! The Ashlock Knight has taken the win!!!

steps.name: Greatmouth Mob
steps.text: Hold on, now Ashlock is aiming the barrel at Brassrust again! Could it be? The day the tyrannical Ingra is humiliated himself?!

steps.name: Brassrust Knight
steps.text: ...Rgh. A Zalak shrunken in a shell.

steps.name: Brassrust Knight
steps.text: Ashlock... Greynuty... I'll remember... you.

steps.name: Brassrust Knight
steps.text: When I'm healed... you... you Infected—will not live to tell one tale!

steps.name: Greynuty
steps.text: —You!

steps.name: Greynuty
steps.text: (Pulls the trigger)

steps.name: Brassrust Knight
steps.text: Kgh...

steps.name: Greynuty
steps.text: (Aims barrel at the sky)

steps.name: Greynuty
steps.text: This shell is an offering to the spectators.

steps.name: Greynuty
steps.text: You don't deserve it.

steps.name: Brassrust Knight
steps.text: You... urgh...

steps.name: Greatmouth Mob
steps.text: The Ashlock Knight has not dealt a closing blow to Ingra! With a final blast of a shell, she's left alone for the exit!

steps.name: Excited Fan
steps.text: Greynuty! Greynuty—!

steps.name: Greatmouth Mob
steps.text: This match's—lottery—prize—

steps.name: Girl's Father
steps.text: How did you feel on that run?

steps.name: Grown Girl
steps.text: Not that good, Father. My hand still gets tremors holding the cannonlance for too long.

steps.name: Girl's Father
steps.text: Do you want to switch to a lighter weapon?

steps.name: Grown Girl
steps.text: No. The cannonlance suits me. Its might makes up for what I lack in flexibility.

steps.name: Grown Girl
steps.text: And besides, someday, I might not be fighting in the arena, but somewhere much vaster.

steps.name: Grown Girl
steps.text: Just like Grandmother.

steps.name: Grown Girl
steps.text: When that time comes, this weapon will surely be much more practical.

steps.name: Girl's Father
steps.text: Alright... as you wish.

steps.name: Girl's Father
steps.text: My little nut.

steps.name: Grown Girl
steps.text: Father, I'm not a child anymore. You don't need to call me that...

steps.name: Girl's Father
steps.text: Fair.

steps.name: Girl's Father
steps.text: Greynuty.

steps.name: Girl's Father
steps.text: You did well in training.

steps.name: Girl's Father
steps.text: If Grandma could see the strides you've made, I'm sure she'd be delighted.

steps.name: Grown Girl
steps.text: Grandmother...

steps.name: Girl's Father
steps.text: Before Grandma left, she made an agreement with some of the uncles. As long as you're willing to learn, they'll continue to pay your fees.

steps.name: Girl's Father
steps.text: So you don't need to worry about money.

steps.name: Girl's Father
steps.text: Whether or not you become a knight in the end, or inherit the family business.

steps.name: Girl's Father
steps.text: Keep practicing, and there'll be a day you become a famed cannonlancer of Kazimierz.

steps.name: Girl's Father
steps.text: Ah, how many generations it's been since the Kaliskas last had a true cannonlancer.

steps.name: Girl's Father
steps.text: All your ancestors would be proud of you.

steps.name: Girl's Father
steps.text: Don't let them down.

steps.name: Grown Girl
steps.text: Yes, Father.

steps.name: Grown Girl
steps.text: I won't.

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: Hey, Ashley. Ashley?

steps.name: Greynuty
steps.text: Um—muh?

steps.name: Greynuty
steps.text: What's the matter?

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: What were you daydreaming about?

steps.name: Greynuty
steps.text: Nothing. Just thinking.

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: Poor-ass Ingra. Just came out of the hospital and you send him right back.

steps.name: Greynuty
steps.text: He deserves it.

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: And you still fired your last round in the air?

steps.name: Greynuty
steps.text: The match was already over. Even if I can't stand the sight of Ingra, I won't do anything else to him.

steps.name: Greynuty
steps.text: Otherwise, what would separate me and him?

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: Shame, I was looking forward to a 'Butcher Suffers Slaughter'-type headline in the papers...

steps.name: Greynuty
steps.text: Chances are the Ingra family wouldn't let that news onto the papers at all.

steps.name: Greynuty
steps.text: Sona, I've actually been meaning to ask you for a little bit now...

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: Hm? What's up, Ashley?

steps.name: Greynuty
steps.text: What are you—holding there?

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: An Ashlock water bottle.

steps.name: Greynuty
steps.text: Why would you buy something so useless?

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: It worked out. I was thirsty, I couldn't be bothered to go out to buy water.

steps.name: Iwona
steps.text: Yoo. Our knight returns triumphant.

steps.name: Justyna
steps.text: I'll have to learn from you too, Ashlock, and become stronger.

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: Justyna, how'd 'that' go?

steps.name: Justyna
steps.text: It's done.

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: Alrighty. Good work, nice.

steps.name: Greynuty
steps.text: Once the reward hits, I'll wire it over to 'that account.' Word is the bank there's already watching frequent transfers.

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: Can we still use personal expenses for the ruse?

steps.name: Greynuty
steps.text: What do you think?

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: Yeah, fair...

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: We don't have much time left.

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: But we don't need to think about it just yet.

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: First, let's go celebrate!
